separateConsumerSuite.coverageInterpretation: Not included in provider-suite coverage or provider mutation instrumentation. Execute the separate ConsumerKit suite and measure its own coverage before claiming full client qualification.

platformBindingExclusions.justification: Dalamud IPluginConfiguration binding; persistence and configuration write coordination are included pure code.
Dalamud configuration API bridge; file validation and serialized writes are included pure code.

Dalamud service composition, command/event registration, UI dispatch and native lifecycle. ConfigurationPolicy, IntentAdmissionPolicy and LifecycleCleanup own included version, admission and owned-worker shutdown decisions.

Native/managed game API reads, transient pointer/container identity rechecks and live memory observations. CaptureReadPolicy, notebook mapping, dresser expansion and retainer accumulation are included.
Public Dalamud event subscriptions and native row identification. PromptCaptureHintBuffer classification, coalescing, burst limits and lifetime behavior are included alongside PromptCapturePolicy.
Framework-thread and game-service bridge to included catalog cache, read operation and snapshot controller.
Native window/manager observation and byte/ID fingerprint acquisition. Storage readiness and window-edge transition policies are included.
Lumina typed-sheet access and projection input acquisition. CatalogRowPolicy eligibility, bounded projection, mapping and catalog acceptance are included.
Exact API 15 call-gate registration/invocation/disposal. Publication, notice coalescing and evidence acceptance policies are included.
Framework-thread acquisition of native framework timing and bounded game-version bytes. DiagnosticSamplingPolicy owns included validity and parsing decisions.
ImGui rendering and click dispatch of prepared diagnostic state. Layout, report validation, redaction, preparation and controller decisions are included.

Native object/addon observation, pointer reacquisition and point-of-action native calls. GuidedAdapterPolicy owns included validation-record applicability and effect/scope authorization; controller and furnishing policies are also included.
Data-only native validation record binds Dalamud ObjectKind and ConditionFlag types; validation applicability decisions are included separately.
Framework-thread bridge for inventory capture; InventoryService and InventoryPolicy remain in the included decision scope.
Inventory type binding and quantity projection dispatch; shared read validation and quantity decisions are included.
Dalamud gate registration and inventory runtime binding; protocol and inventory state decisions remain included.
Framework-thread pointer acquisition and copied slot observations. InventoryContainerReadPolicy validates the full group; InventoryContainerProjection keeps presence and quantity semantics separate.
Native retainer interaction and readiness bridge; RetainerGuideController and RetainerMenuPolicy unique label selection are included.
ImGui header rendering and button intent dispatch from prepared view state.
ImGui window/popup focus, draw lifecycle and intent dispatch; view state, layout and guided transition decisions are included.
ImGui operation controls and intent dispatch; enablement and guided state are prepared by included presenters.
ImGui health rendering and copy-click dispatch; health tone and copy eligibility are included presenter decisions.
ImGui collection table geometry and drawing of prepared counts, markers and deltas; count and delta computations are included.
ImGui history summary drawing and history-view intent dispatch.
ImGui drawing, hover tooltip and visual button primitives; tooltip content and visual tokens are included.
Native game-setting read; ThemeObservationPolicy polling/failure retention and prepared presentation are included.
Local ImGui vector icon drawing switch; no collection, lifecycle or action authorization decision.
ImGui style push/pop bridge; visual token values are included.

Exact API 15 consumer gate binding/subscription bridge. CollectionDataIpcClient decisions are tested by the separate ConsumerKit test suite; provider-suite coverage does not establish client coverage.
